panel.title: Sui Sui Nian
panel.subtitle: Keep track of friends' birthdays. On the day, the character naturally brings it up in her first proactive chat. Import a spreadsheet, mark gift-ahead or special-care friends.
panel.today.title: Today
panel.today.empty: No friend has a birthday today.
panel.people.title: Birthday list
panel.people.searchHelp: Filter by name, birthday, note or tag.
panel.people.empty: No records yet. Add a friend below.
panel.table.name: Name
panel.form.name: Name
panel.form.birthdayHelp: Calculated on the Gregorian calendar. Accepts 1995-08-12, 08-12, 1995/8/12 or 1995年8月12日. Without a year it repeats every year.
panel.form.notePlaceholder: e.g. likes coffee, no expensive gifts
panel.form.tagGift: Gift ahead (remind me N days before to prepare a gift)
panel.form.tagSpecial: Special care (higher priority and pinned in the list)
panel.toast.testSent: Test reminder sent — see if she speaks up
panel.import.title: Import a spreadsheet
panel.import.help: Supports .xlsx / .xlsm / .csv. The first row must include the headers 姓名, 生日, 备注, 标记. Rows with the same name and month/day are updated; others are added. Tags: 提前提醒送礼, 特别关心 (comma separated).
panel.import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 4 MB. Please keep only the rows you need.
panel.settings.title: Reminder settings
panel.settings.remindAfterHelp: After this time the character speaks up proactively. 08:00–09:00 is a good default.
panel.settings.quietAfterHelp: No reminders are sent after this time.
panel.settings.repeatHelp: How long to wait before reminding again when not confirmed.
panel.settings.maxHelp: After reaching the limit, no more reminders until tomorrow.
panel.settings.advanceHelp: For friends tagged 提前提醒送礼, remind this many days before the birthday. 0 disables it.
panel.settings.cue: Put the birthday into the character's context before the first proactive chat (no extra message)
panel.settings.scan: Detect phrases like “already greeted” or “stop reminding” from recent chats
